mintAuthority.headline: mGLO allows unbounded direct operator minting across Base, Robinhood Chain, and Ethereum behind two-day upgrade timelocks.
mintAuthority.summary: mGLO has native issuer deployments on Base, Robinhood Chain, and Ethereum. Shared operator EOA 0xa13f82f679e24ad08e014f8af6ece32023b14f07 can mint directly on all three native deployments alongside verified DepositVault proxies on Robinhood Chain and Ethereum. Chain-local 1-of-3 Safes and a shared EOA hold immediate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to rotate minters, while native token, vault, and MidasAccessControl proxies upgrade through chain-local ProxyAdmins owned by two-day timelocks. X Layer, Optimism, and Monad LayerZero extensions are scored separately in Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Pinned on-chain reads on 2026-11-27 across Base (finalized block 62967570), Robinhood Chain (block 124271103), and Ethereum (finalized block 26506658) established that mGLO has canonical native issuance on all three chains. Shared operator EOA 0xa13f82f679e24ad08e014f8af6ece32023b14f07 holds M_GLO_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on all three chains without an on-chain supply cap, alongside DepositVault proxies on Robinhood Chain (0x2a3b139e...4791) and Ethereum (0xe6522c0b...6e91). Immediate minter rotation is controlled by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by 1-of-3 Safes (0xb60842e9... on Base and Ethereum; 0x563e0fc2... on Robinhood Chain) and shared EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227. Native transparent proxies resolve through chain-local ProxyAdmins owned by 172800-second TimelockControllers controlled by those 1-of-3 Safes. X Layer, Optimism, and Monad are interconnected via immutable 27,366-byte LayerZero V2 MidasLzMintBurnOFTAdapters with zero locked escrow and are reviewed in bridgeRouteRisk. Economic-control evidence: JTC Luxembourg independently values Compartment mGLO (ISIN LU3357216087) monthly; SAVE attestation CID QmeNwyuVyhM5HvEFfKZH9j7zCCvGrLwCBf1hYeWsTocMt1 (created 2026-11-25, expires 2026-12-02) notarizes the 2026-10-31 JTC valuation ($193,415,658.76 against 186,822,750.69 tokens, ratio 1.017784) via vlayer TLS-Notary and Chainlink CRE. The exempt Luxembourg securitisation compartment is not evidenced as a prudentially supervised fund, and unbounded issuer direct-mint and immediate admin paths establish unbounded-reconciled posture.
